messages:
Alice: Kicking off preflight for the "circuit throttle" rollforward. Targets: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pinning service-model to v2-quant for EU/APAC. Rollback triggers: >=2% error rate or p95 latency > 1200ms for >10m. See release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20/rc-4

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (id: db-2239001234). Targets: us-central1, eu-west1, asia-southeast1. Canary config: 5% traffic -> 30m -> promote.

Bennett: Quick capacity check — do we have warm pool cushion in APAC? Last night's surge ate into warm pool.

Ciara: APAC warm pool: 6/8 nodes warm (75%). Reserved GPUs: US 40, EU 28, APAC 8. Expected QPS baseline: US 3200, EU 2100, APAC 900. Command I ran:
```
rwctl pool status --region asia-southeast1
# shows 6/8 warm
```

ops-lead: Hold APAC rollout until warm pool >=80% or we can add burst nodes. Also pin fallback to model variant `v2-quant` in case of OOMs. Otherwise proceed with US canary.

Alice: Noted. Canary should validate: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 1200ms, error_rate < 0.5%. I'll start US canary now once I get final acks.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-central1 (id: db-2239001234-canary) — 5% traffic. Started at 2239001245.

Bennett: Heads up — we saw a bursty embedding pattern yesterday from partner X, QPS spikes up to 5x baseline. Recommending temporary batch_size bump to 16 for embeddings during rollout :warning:

Ciara: Agree. Quick throttle rule to apply to APAC to protect warm pool:
```
route_policy:
  throttle_apac:
    max_qps: 1200
    burst: 300
```
I'll stage that if ops-lead approves.

ops-lead: Approve throttle rule for APAC. Add it as a temporary policy with a 2h TTL.

Alice: Final ack from eng-releases: ready to proceed with US -> EU. APAC remains on HOLD until warm pool >=80% or +2 nodes added. Say :thumbsup: to proceed.

Bennett: :+1:
Ciara: :+1:
ops-lead: :+1:

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to EU (id: db-2239001234-eu-roll) — starting rollout slice 10% -> 30% over 20m. APAC slice remains pinned to HOLD. ETA to EU at 2239001340.

Alice: Logging decision: APAC hold, throttle in place, fallback model pinned. Will monitor for 1h, then re-evaluate.

Ciara: I'll watch warm pool and add nodes if we cross threshold.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: US promoted -> EU canary started. All actions logged in deployment dashboard.
